name: tui-design
title_zh: 把终端界面从能用改到好用，一次装齐
tagline_zh: 改 lazygit 布局、给 k9s 加筛选、让 btop 配色不刺眼——不用翻源码，直接说人话。
tagline_en: Reshape lazygit, add filters to k9s, fix btop's glare—no source-diving. Just say it; it speaks Bubble Tea.
desc_en: Design, build, refactor, or review terminal interfaces—full-screen TUIs, interactive prompts, and command-line tools. Use for terminal-app layout and UX, CLI behavior, ncurses-style tools, dashboards, REPLs, fzf-like pickers, and libraries such as Bubble Tea, Ratatui, Textual, or Ink, including requests that name a known TUI such as lazygit, k9s, btop, helix, or yazi instead of saying “TUI.” Do no
why_zh: 不是泛泛的代码生成器，它按 TUI 的渲染循环、事件模型和布局约束来思考，改完不破坏键盘流和刷新节奏。
why_en: Not a generic codegen—it reasons in render loops, event models, and layout constraints, so edits keep keyboard flow and refresh.
limit_zh: 只认终端界面这一格：不碰 GUI 桌面应用、不写后端 API、不做数据管道。产物是代码改动建议和 diff。
limit_en: Terminal UI only: no desktop GUI, no backend APIs, no data pipelines. Outputs diffs and suggestions—won't run tests or deploy. Deep IPC or async.
